One of the worst things that can happen in the Zone is being caught off guard. The QR system cannot prevent such situations, but it can definitely help you escape them. It works simply: it instantly releases the backpack straps so you can run to safety without the extra weight. To use the QR system, assign it to a hotkey (F1-F4 or an alternative). Press that hotkey to activate the quick-release system, which instantly drops your backpack and everything inside it. Your equipped weapon, ammunition, armor, and technology items stay with you, so you can defend yourself. You can retrieve the backpack later.

A very sturdy backpack with a built-in GPS sensor. It syncs with your PDA automatically when you create a stash and immediately marks it on the PDA map. The backpack is made of strong, durable materials that protect its contents in any environment. Its camouflage fabric helps the stash blend into the surroundings.

A heavy set of hooks, knives, and other tools for professional field dressing. It is packed into separate sections of a regular backpack, leaving room for trophies. Mutations and widespread disease have left the organs of local wildlife in terrible condition, nearly useless for study, while their meat is tainted with parasites and rot.
The hunting kit lets you examine the organs more thoroughly while gutting an animal and protects scientific samples from damage during butchering, helping you get the most out of a mutant carcass. Because the gutting process is unpleasant and valuable parts are relatively rare, most stalkers still prefer scavenging and searching for artifacts, where luck matters more than skill.
